title: The Heavenly Dao Collapses
next_chapter_hook: Just when Chen Ji thought the overall situation was settled, a massive projection of the Axis of Fate suddenly emerged from the depths of the Heavenly Realm's core, and the patterns flowing across it were exactly the same as the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand...

text.content: Cang Yutian's loud laughter echoed through the Heavenly Realm. Chen Ji stood at the center of the collapsing Heavenly Dao's chain of causality, the power of fate around him surging like angry tides. The old world's order was crumbling beneath his feet, countless threads of causality like torn silk drifting and dissolving in the void. His Tianji Record Fragment radiated unprecedented light—that was the unique phenomenon when the Fourth Path was opened—transcending fate, monopolizing causality.

Yet Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly. He could sense that the collapse of the old Heavenly Dao was far from silent—a massive force of backlash was converging from all directions, like a wounded beast making its final desperate struggle. Fragments of the Heavenly Dao's Eye's will stirred restlessly across the Heavenly Realm, unwilling to let their grand chess game be overturned.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji! Your aura is vanishing rapidly!" Su Qingyao's voice rang out from the distance, carrying an unprecedented urgency. She was sprinting across the fractured Heavenly Ladder, her composure as an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow completely abandoned, "Heavenly Fate—your Heavenly Fate is plummeting!"

text.content: Chen Ji didn't turn around. He understood what was happening—each evolution of the Tianji Record demanded a price, and this time, he wasn't paying with Heavenly Fate, but with the entire old Heavenly Dao's causality. In the distance, demonic path mists churned, Ye Qing's Saint power shielding the Tianji Record's presence, yet the backlash of causality still pressed down with tangible weight.

At this moment, a warm, familiar light rose from Chen Ji's chest. Chen Ling—his long-lost sister—her soul fragments gained a chance at independent existence when the Fourth Path opened. From within that light, Chen Ling's voice rang out clearly for the first time: "Brother, I'm here."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji! Are you certain about this path?" Ye Qing's demonic path mist formed a barrier around Chen Ji, her voice drifting through the fog, "The old Heavenly Dao's backlash isn't something you can endure alone—sharing our bond power with you might mean completely losing control of the Fourth Path!"

text.content: Roaring sounds echoed across the Heavenly Realm. The battle between the Demonic Path commander and Heavenly Dao remnants had spread to the core regions. Countless fragments of Heavenly Dao laws fell like meteors, crashing into the chaotic currents of causality surrounding Chen Ji. The entire Heavenly Realm trembled, the collapse of the old order accelerating. Whether Chen Ji's Fourth Path would remain stable would determine the ultimate outcome of everything.

choice.prompt: The old Heavenly Dao's backlash surged like a tide, forcing Chen Ji to make a choice—accept the bond power from his allies and share the risk, or bear it alone?

choices.text: Protect the Bonds, Share Heavenly Fate
choices.description: Accept Su Qingyao and Ye Qing's bond power, allowing them to share the causal backlash together. This would make the Fourth Path unstable, but maintain the team's integrity.
choices.visible_cost: Lose complete control over the Fourth Path
choices.visible_reward: Gain bond resonance, with Heavenly Fate consumption shared among three people
choices.risk_hint: The fates of three are linked; if one is injured, all suffer

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hesitate. He opened his arms, embracing that warm bond power. Su Qingyao's cyan light and Ye Qing's demonic purple glow surged into him simultaneously. Three forces intertwined and resonated on the Tianji Record Fragment. An unprecedented sense of fullness rose in Chen Ji's heart—he was no longer alone.

dialogue.content: "You...fool!" Su Qingyao's voice carried a tone of crying yet full of strength, "From now on, we share Heavenly Fate together!"

choices.memory_label: 与苏青瑶、夜清建立共命羁绊

choices.text: Stabilize the situation, bear the backlash alone
choices.description: Reject bond power, using one's own Heavenly Fate to forcefully resist the old Heavenly Dao's causal backlash. This would consume massive Heavenly Fate, but ensure complete control over the Fourth Path.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 30 points of Heavenly Fate, old Heavenly Dao backlash causes internal injuries
choices.visible_reward: Maintain absolute control over the Fourth Path, solidify the foundation of the new world
choices.risk_hint: Foresight ability may temporarily fail due to low Heavenly Fate

text.content: Chen Ji gently shook his head, whispering: 'This is my choice; you shouldn't bear it.' He blocked all bond power outside and faced the torrent of Heavenly Dao backlash alone. Intense pain surged from his soul's depths, but he gritted his teeth, not retreating a single step.

dialogue.content: "This man..." Ye Qing's gaze was complicated, for the first time truly feeling Chen Ji's stubbornness and gentleness, "He always carries all burdens on his shoulders alone."

choices.memory_label: 陈机独承天道反噬，稳固第四条路

choices.text: Go all out, attack to defend
choices.description: Not defending against the backlash, but taking the initiative to strike, using the Tianji Record to foresee the loopholes in Heavenly Dao and destroy the source of backlash before it can fully manifest. This is the most radical choice, but may lead to unforeseen consequences.
choices.visible_cost: May trigger a greater karmic backlash
choices.visible_reward: Completely destroy the core of the old Heavenly Dao's karmic chain
choices.risk_hint: Foresight may become blurred due to Chen Ling's presence, extremely high risk

text.content: A sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. He sharply turned around, facing the source of that backlash force—a core woven from countless threads of Heavenly Dao karma, madly pulsing in the depths of the celestial realm. "Since you want to backlash, then let it backlash to its heart's content!" He activated the Tianji Record and charged directly forward.

dialogue.content: "Brother!" Chen Ling's voice suddenly became clear. "I can help you—I see it! At the deepest part of the karmic core, there's a crack!"

choices.memory_label: 陈机借助陈灵的指引直捣黄龙

text.content: No matter what choice Chen Ji made, the torrent of karmic backlash peaked in an instant. The karmic chain of the old Heavenly Dao began to completely shatter under the impact of his choice, countless lights drifting through the void—those were the traces of Heavenly Dao's will from past epochs, being erased by the new order.

Yet at this moment, a sudden transformation occurred. In the depths of the celestial realm's core, a dark light suddenly blazed forth—an authentic fragment of the Heavenly Dao's Eye, a force suppressed for countless ages. It had been waiting, waiting for someone to overturn the chessboard, and now, that person had arrived.

dialogue.content: Innumerable cold wills gathered from across the celestial realm, condensing before Chen Ji into a massive eye. "Interesting..." The voice seemed to emanate from eons past. "You believe you've overturned the chessboard? Regrettably, you've merely switched to a far grander game board."

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at the will projection, a cold smile curling at his lips. Slowly, he raised the fragment of the Tianji Record in his hand, its intricate patterns further improving at an almost incomprehensible speed. "Is that so? Then let me see, on your chessboard, how many pieces truly belong to you."

The celestial realm's core began to violently tremble. The battle between the Demonic Path's commander and Heavenly Dao's remnants had reached a white-hot intensity, with countless law fragments scattering in all directions. The entire celestial realm was plunged into unprecedented chaos. Yet at the heart of this turmoil, Chen Ji stood like a grounding pillar, firmly rooted in the vortex of karmic rupture.

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Dao's Eye's will projection materialized before Chen Ji, forcing him to decide how to confront this ultimate existence—whether to directly oppose it or seek another breakthrough.

choices.text: Direct confrontation, revealing its true form
choices.description: Using the power of the Tianji Record to directly illuminate the true essence of the Heavenly Dao's Eye, exposing it before all eyes. This is the most dangerous frontal confrontation, but if successful, it will completely dismantle the Heavenly Dao's Eye's prestige.
choices.visible_cost: Consuming massive amounts of Heavenly Fate Value, potentially triggering the old Heavenly Dao's final backlash
choices.visible_reward: Completely exposing the Heavenly Dao's Eye's true face, allowing everyone to perceive its fundamental nature
choices.risk_hint: Should failure occur, one would become a puppet of the Heavenly Dao's Eye

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate for a moment. Raising the Tianji Record fragment high above his head, he intoned in a low voice: "Tianji reveals, all laws return to origin!" The patterns on the fragment blazed suddenly, and a brilliant beam of light shot directly toward the will projection.

dialogue.content: "You—!" The Heavenly Dao's Eye's projection shuddered violently, the dark layer of light beginning to collapse and reveal its true form—below was not some so-called Heavenly Dao will, but an eerie existence assembled from countless grudges and obsessions.

choices.memory_label: 陈机揭露天道之眼真正本质

choices.text: Bypass the projection, stabilize the new realm
choices.description: Avoiding direct confrontation with the Heavenly Dao's Eye, instead seizing the opportunity to accelerate stabilizing the fourth path and carving out a foundation for one's own new world. As long as the foundation remains solid, the Heavenly Dao's Eye can never truly control him.
choices.visible_cost: For now, unable to completely eliminate the threat of the Heavenly Dao's Eye
choices.visible_reward: New world foundation stabilized, obtaining true independent status
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Dao's Eye may take advantage of this moment to establish plans elsewhere

text.content: Chen Ji let out a cold laugh, his form suddenly vanishing from its original location. When he reappeared, he stood in the deepest chaos of the celestial realm. Around him, Chen Ling's light was rapidly condensing, as the embryonic form of an entirely new world took shape.

dialogue.content: You think you can escape?" The Voice of Heavenly Dao's Eye rang out from all directions, "Wherever you hide, you are still on my chessboard!"

text.content: The tremors in the Heavenly Realm's core grew increasingly violent. The causal chain of the old Heavenly Dao shattered completely due to Chen Ji's choice, but this severed force did not disappear—instead it transformed into countless fragments of karma, scattered throughout the entire Heavenly Realm. Some fragments fell upon the mortal world, triggering countless strange upheavals; some fragments fell upon cultivators, granting them powers that did not originally belong to them.

At that moment, a massive pillar of light suddenly emerged from the depths of the Heavenly Realm's core. Within that pillar of light, an ancient Book of Destiny slowly manifested, its flowing patterns exactly matching the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's hand, yet impossibly complete. That was—the complete Tianji Record itself.

dialogue.content: The voice of the Remnant Soul Guardian suddenly rang out in Chen Ji's mind, carrying unprecedented gravity: "Master, this is the true test. The complete Tianji Record has appeared—what you hold is merely the tip of the iceberg. Now, you must make a choice: integrate the fragment into the main body to obtain complete power, or maintain independence and continue walking your own path?"

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at the slowly rotating Book of Destiny within that pillar of light, his eyes deep and profound. He could sense the terrifying power contained within that book—it was the crystallization of wisdom from all prophets throughout countless years, the core pivot of Heavenly Dao's operation. Once integrated, he would gain the ability to rewrite destiny; but at the same time, he would completely become a piece in the Heavenly Dao's chess game, never again able to transcend.

choice.prompt: The complete Tianji Record appeared before Chen Ji—this was temptation unprecedented. Integrating with it would grant the power to rewrite destiny, but the cost was becoming forever part of Heavenly Dao. How to choose?

choices.text: Integrate with the main body, obtain completeness
choices.description: Integrate the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand into the main body, obtaining the complete Tianji Record abilities. This would grant him the power to rewrite destiny, but also subject him to the Tianji Record main body's constraints.
choices.visible_cost: Forever become part of the Tianji Record, losing partial free will
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete Tianji Record abilities, able to foresee and rewrite any destiny
choices.risk_hint: Risk following in the footsteps of previous prophets, becoming a new chess piece

text.content: Chen Ji slowly walked toward that pillar of light, reaching out to touch the Book of Destiny. In that instant, countless streams of information flooded into his mind—the memories of countless prophets, the experiences of all previous Tianji Record masters, the core laws of Heavenly Dao's operation. He saw his own past, present, and future, all recorded within this book.

dialogue.content: "Master..." The Remnant Soul Guardian's voice carried a complex emotion, "Are you certain? Once integrated, you will no longer be an ordinary cultivator, but the embodiment of the Tianji Record..."

choices.memory_label: 陈机选择融入天机录本体

choices.description: Refuse integration with the main body, continue walking one's own fourth path. Though the power is inferior to the complete Tianji Record, one can maintain absolute independence and freedom.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the opportunity to obtain the complete Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independent will, the fourth path will not be bound by the main body
choices.risk_hint: Need to face the continuous threat of the Heavenly Dao's Eye

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his hand and stepped back. His gaze was calm yet resolute: "I don't need to become anyone's embodiment." He turned to look at Chen Ling, Su Qingyao, and Ye Qing behind him, "My path, I walk myself."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's eyes reddened slightly, yet her smile was brighter than ever: "This is the Chen Ji I know."

choices.memory_label: 陈机拒绝天机录，选择独立之路

text.content: The moment Chen Ji made his choice, a brilliant light suddenly erupted from the depths of the Heavenly Realm's core. That was the projection of the Destiny Axis—a massive, axis-like object woven from countless threads of karma, slowly manifesting at the highest point of the heavens. Its appearance signaled that the final remnants of the old Heavenly Dao order were being cleared away, and new world rules were being established. And Chen Ji, as the pioneer of the fourth path, stood precisely at this critical juncture of transition between the old and new, bearing the gaze of all.
